roleMenu.defaultSingle: Pick your role in the menu below. Picking another one replaces it.
roleMenu.defaultMultiple: Pick your roles in the menu below. Picking a role you already have removes it.
roleMenu.alreadyHave: You already have this role: nothing changed.
roleMenu.nothingToRemove: You have none of this menu's roles.
roleMenu.unknownMenu: This menu is no longer active. Ask a server manager to publish it again from the MLBBDex dashboard.
roleMenu.unknownOption: This choice is no longer in the menu. Ask a server manager to publish it again.
roleMenu.rateLimited: Slow down: wait a few seconds before changing your roles again.
roleMenu.refusedRole: One of these roles no longer exists. Ask a server manager to update the menu.
roleMenu.refusedBot: MLBBDex can no longer give this role: it needs the Manage Roles permission and its role above this one. Ask a server manager.
roleMenu.refusedGranter: This menu is paused: the manager who set it up can no longer give these roles. Another manager has to save it again on the MLBBDex dashboard.
roleMenu.failed: Your roles could not be changed right now. Try again in a moment.
